title: Accounting: Direct cost
description:
> **Language tip:** Direct costs may also be referred to as **Spend transactions**, **Spend money transactions**, or **Payments** in various accounting software.

## Overview

Direct costs are money that leave the business without impacting Accounts Payable, and refunds associated with such transactions.

Direct costs include:
  * Purchasing an item and paying it off at the point of the purchase
  * Receiving cash from a refunded item if the refund is made by the supplier

Direct costs is a child data type of [account transactions](https://docs.codat.io/lending-api#/schemas/AccountTransaction).

id.description: Identifier of the direct cost, unique for the company.

reference.description: User-friendly reference for the direct cost.

note.description: A note attached to the direct cost.

contactRef.description: A customer or supplier associated with the direct cost.

issueDate.description: Date of the direct cost as recorded in the accounting software.Date of the direct cost as recorded in the accounting software.

subTotal.description: The total amount of the direct costs, excluding any taxes.

taxAmount.description: The total amount of tax on the direct costs.

totalAmount.description: The amount of the direct costs, inclusive of tax.

description.description: Friendly name of the goods or services.

unitAmount.description:
Price of each unit of goods or services.
Note: If the platform does not provide this information, the unit amount will be mapped to the total amount.

quantity.description:
Number of units of goods or services received.

Note: If the platform does not provide this information, the quantity will be mapped as 1.

discountAmount.description: Discount amount for the line before tax.

discountPercentage.description: Discount percentage for the line before tax.

subTotal.description: Amount of the line, inclusive of discounts but exclusive of tax.

taxAmount.description: Amount of tax for the line.

totalAmount.description: Total amount of the line, including tax.

accountRef.description: Reference to the account to which the line item is linked.

taxRateRef.description: Reference to the tax rate to which the the line item is linked.

itemRef.description: Reference to the product, service type, or inventory item to which the direct cost is linked.

trackingCategoryRefs.description: Collection of categories against which this direct cost is tracked.
